  "title": "HR Business Partner",
  "description": "Olam Agri is a market-leading, differentiated food, feed, and fiber agri-business with a global origination footprint, processing capabilities, and deep understanding of market needs built over 33 years. With a strong presence in high-growth emerging markets and products across grains &amp; oilseeds, animal feed &amp; protein, rice, edible oils, specialty grains &amp; seeds, cotton, wood products, rubber and commodity financial services.

Olam Agri is at the heart of global food and agri-trade flows with more than 40 million MT in volume traded annually. Focused on transforming food, feed and fiber for a more sustainable future, it aims at creating value for customers, enabling farming communities to prosper sustainably, and strive for a food-secure future.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: HR Business Partner

Job Location: Apapa(Wheat), Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description


	The HR Business Partner will serve as a strategic advisor to Manufacturing, Technical and Supply Chain leadership teams, driving HR initiatives that strengthen organizational capability, enhance talent quality, and support high?performance culture across plant and field operations.
	role ensures seamless execution of people processes, workforce planning, capability development, and HR compliance within the manufacturing ecosystem, by effectively partnering with the various COE&rsquo;s.


Responsibilities
Strategic HR Business Partnering:


	Act as a trusted advisor to MATS leadership, providing data-driven insights to influence people decisions and organizational effectiveness.
	Partner with business units to understand operational priorities and translate them into HR interventions that improve productivity and workforce engagement.
	Drive workforce planning, succession planning, and capability-building strategies aligned with business growth.


Talent Acquisition &amp; Workforce Deployment:


	Partner with the TA team to attract, assess, and onboard high-quality technical, engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain talent.
	Ensure staffing for plants, mills, factories, warehouses, and field operations is aligned with business timelines and manpower budgets.
	Support graduate trainee intake and deployment across technical and manufacturing functions.


Performance &amp; Capability Development:


	Drive the annual performance management cycle, ensuring fairness, quality of evaluations, and leadership accountability.
	Identify skill gaps and coordinate functional capability development programs for plant managers, shift supervisors, engineers, quality teams, and supply chain staff.
	Support leadership development pipelines for critical MATS roles.


HR Operations &amp; Process Excellence:


	Partner with Plant HR/IR Managers to deliver end?to?end people processes including onboarding, confirmations, transfers, exits, HR documentation, and payroll inputs.
	Partner with C&amp;B team to ensure data accuracy and timely updates on HR systems (e.g., SuccessFactors, HRIS).
	Lead continuous improvement initiatives to simplify HR processes across manufacturing locations.


Culture, Engagement &amp; Change Management:


	Partner with L&amp;D to champion company values and drive culture-building initiatives across plants, warehouses, and field operations.
	Lead engagement activities, pulse surveys, and action planning to improve employee morale and retention.
	Support change management for organizational transformation, restructuring, or process redesign initiatives.


Qualifications


	Bachelor&rsquo;s Degree from reputed university/ specialization in Human Resources, Industrial Relations, Business Administration or related field is an advantage, through not mandatory. Certification from institutes such as CIPM, SHRM, HRCI is an advantage
	10&ndash;12 years of progressive HR experience, with at least 6 years partnering with manufacturing/technical/supply chain operations.
	Proven experience in talent planning, capability development, and improving employee experience in a high?performance, fast-paced environment.

        Olam Agri is a market-leading, differentiated food, feed, and fiber agri-business with a global origination footprint, processing capabilities, and deep understanding of market needs built over 33 years. With a strong presence in high-growth emerging markets and products across grains & oilseeds, animal feed & protein, rice, edible oils, specialty grains & seeds, cotton, wood products, rubber and commodity financial services.

Olam Agri is at the heart of global food and agri-trade flows with more than 40 million MT in volume traded annually. Focused on transforming food, feed and fiber for a more sustainable future, it aims at creating value for customers, enabling farming communities to prosper sustainably, and strive for a food-secure future.
     

            
    



We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: HR Business Partner

Job Location: Apapa(Wheat), Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description


	The HR Business Partner will serve as a strategic advisor to Manufacturing, Technical and Supply Chain leadership teams, driving HR initiatives that strengthen organizational capability, enhance talent quality, and support high?performance culture across plant and field operations.
	role ensures seamless execution of people processes, workforce planning, capability development, and HR compliance within the manufacturing ecosystem, by effectively partnering with the various COE’s.


Responsibilities
Strategic HR Business Partnering:


	Act as a trusted advisor to MATS leadership, providing data-driven insights to influence people decisions and organizational effectiveness.
	Partner with business units to understand operational priorities and translate them into HR interventions that improve productivity and workforce engagement.
	Drive workforce planning, succession planning, and capability-building strategies aligned with business growth.


Talent Acquisition & Workforce Deployment:


	Partner with the TA team to attract, assess, and onboard high-quality technical, engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain talent.
	Ensure staffing for plants, mills, factories, warehouses, and field operations is aligned with business timelines and manpower budgets.
	Support graduate trainee intake and deployment across technical and manufacturing functions.


Performance & Capability Development:


	Drive the annual performance management cycle, ensuring fairness, quality of evaluations, and leadership accountability.
	Identify skill gaps and coordinate functional capability development programs for plant managers, shift supervisors, engineers, quality teams, and supply chain staff.
	Support leadership development pipelines for critical MATS roles.


HR Operations & Process Excellence:


	Partner with Plant HR/IR Managers to deliver end?to?end people processes including onboarding, confirmations, transfers, exits, HR documentation, and payroll inputs.
	Partner with C&B team to ensure data accuracy and timely updates on HR systems (e.g., SuccessFactors, HRIS).
	Lead continuous improvement initiatives to simplify HR processes across manufacturing locations.


Culture, Engagement & Change Management:


	Partner with L&D to champion company values and drive culture-building initiatives across plants, warehouses, and field operations.
	Lead engagement activities, pulse surveys, and action planning to improve employee morale and retention.
	Support change management for organizational transformation, restructuring, or process redesign initiatives.


Qualifications


	Bachelor’s Degree from reputed university/ specialization in Human Resources, Industrial Relations, Business Administration or related field is an advantage, through not mandatory. Certification from institutes such as CIPM, SHRM, HRCI is an advantage
	10–12 years of progressive HR experience, with at least 6 years partnering with manufacturing/technical/supply chain operations.
	Proven experience in talent planning, capability development, and improving employee experience in a high?performance, fast-paced environment.

Test Engineer / User Scenario (Mobile Application Testing) Job at Transsion Holdings




        
    

        
        Transsion Holdings is a leading global technology company specializing in smart devices and consumer electronics. Through its renowned brands—TECNO, Infinix, itel, Oraimo, and Syinix—the company serves millions of customers across Africa and other emerging markets. We are committed to innovation, operational excellence, and developing talented professionals who are passionate about making an impact.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Test Engineer / User Scenario (Mobile Application Testing)

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Overview
     

            
    




	User scenario test engineer, familiar with mobile application testing processes, responsible for scenario test case design and test execution.


Job Responsibilities


	Responsible for compatibility testing of mobile third-party applications to ensure the stable operation of applications under different projects and network environments, thereby achieving the goal of high-quality project delivery.
	Build a scenario library based on local real user behavior, design and test the scenario library for high-frequency and typical scenarios of local users, be responsible for defect follow-up and verification closed-loop, and improve the local experience of the product.
	Familiarize with the latest testing technologies and tools, continuously optimize the testing process, and enhance the team's testing capabilities and efficiency.


Qualifications


	Bachelor's Degree or above in relevant majors such as Computer Science, Communication Engineering, Software Engineering, etc., with strong learning ability, good English proficiency, and preference given to those who can speak Chinese.
	Over 3 years of experience in mobile application testing, familiar with the testing process of the Android platform.
	Have a certain theoretical foundation in User Research, and possess strong capabilities in user scenario testing and test case design.
	Positive attitude, proactive initiative, good communication skills, collaboration skills, and stress tolerance.
	Candidates who speak English and have experience in large mobile phone companies or well-known application testing are preferred.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send CV to [email protected] using theJob Position as subject of the mail

Assistant Manager Job at Zentrix Limited




        
    

        
        Zentrix Limited is a modern Nigerian logistics and supply chain company committed to providing reliable, efficient, and technology-driven transportation solutions for businesses and individuals. We specialize in delivering goods safely and on time while maintaining the highest standards of professionalism, integrity, and customer satisfaction.

At Zentrix Limited, we believe logistics is more than moving goods—it is about connecting businesses, enabling growth, and creating value through dependable delivery services and innovative supply chain solutions.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:
 Job Position: Assistant Manager
Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
     

            
    



Job Description


	We are looking for a responsible Assistant Manager to help organize and run our retail stores and fill in for the store manager when needed.
	Your job will be highly important in ensuring the sales team meets its goals of efficiency and customer satisfaction.


Responsibilities


	Assist the Retail Store Manager in planning and implementing strategies to attract customers
	Coordinate daily customer service operations (e.g. sales processes, orders and payments)
	Track the progress of weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual objectives
	Monitor and maintain store inventory
	Evaluate employee performance and identify hiring and training needs
	Supervise and motivate staff to perform their best
	Coach and support new and existing Sales Associates
	Monitor retail operating costs, budgets and resources
	Suggest sales training programs and techniques
	Communicate with clients and evaluate their needs
	Analyze consumer behavior and adjust product positioning
	Handle complaints from customers
	Research emerging products and use information to update the store’s merchandise
	Create reports, analyze and interpret retail data, like revenues, expenses and competition
	Conduct regular audits to ensure the store is functionable and presentable
	Make sure all employees adhere to company’s policies and guidelines
	Act as our store’s representative and set an example for our staff


Requirements and skills


	Candidates should possess an OND, FSLC, SSCE / GCE / NECO with 0-1 year of working experience.
	Experience with recruiting and performance evaluation processes
	Familiarity with financial and customer service principles
	Good math skills with the ability to create and analyze reports, spreadsheets and sales statistics
	Proficient user of MS Office (MS Excel in particular)
	Leadership and organizational abilities
	Interpersonal and communication skills
	Problem-solving attitude
	Flexibility to work in shifts


Remuneration
N150,000 - N200,000 monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Inventory Assistant Job at Zentrix Limited




        
    

        
        Zentrix Limited is a modern Nigerian logistics and supply chain company committed to providing reliable, efficient, and technology-driven transportation solutions for businesses and individuals. We specialize in delivering goods safely and on time while maintaining the highest standards of professionalism, integrity, and customer satisfaction.

At Zentrix Limited, we believe logistics is more than moving goods—it is about connecting businesses, enabling growth, and creating value through dependable delivery services and innovative supply chain solutions.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Inventory Assistant
     

            
    



Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities


	Receive, inspect, and record incoming goods and materials.
	Organize and store inventory in designated warehouse locations.
	Update inventory records using manual logs or inventory management software.
	Monitor stock levels and promptly report low stock or discrepancies.
	Assist with daily, weekly, and monthly stock counts and reconciliations.
	Prepare inventory reports and maintain accurate documentation.
	Pick, pack, and prepare goods for dispatch.
	Ensure inventory is handled safely to prevent damage or loss.
	Label and categorize inventory for easy identification and retrieval.
	Support warehouse housekeeping and maintain a clean, safe, and organized work environment.
	Collaborate with the Operations, Procurement, and Logistics teams to ensure timely movement of goods.
	Follow company policies, operational procedures, and Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) guidelines.


Qualifications


	Minimum of OND, HND, or Bachelor’s Degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Accounting, or a related field.
	Previous warehouse or inventory experience is an added advantage.
	Fresh graduates with a willingness to learn are encouraged to apply.
